judge.governing_law_identified: The friction power is P = F·v = -mgv(μx cos²α + μy sin²α), so its absolute value is mgv(μx cos²α + μy sin²α).
judge.regime_assumed: Given μx = 0.75 > μy = 0.50, with velocity direction allowed relative to the X axis.

For μx = μy, all angles give the same power magnitude.
